finalText:
**Fixed.** Connection leak in `processOrder` when order validation fails. Added try/finally to ensure release runs even on rejection. All 4 tests pass, including the specific validation-failure test.

Root cause: Job handler acquired connection but had no try/finally, so exceptions skipped the release. API handler already had it. By 02:11:14 UTC, 5 leaked connections exhausted the pool (max size 5) and cascaded to 503s.
